biggest_catch: Trial lessons pay $0 and commission starts at 33% - your first weeks are the lowest-paid until reviews and hours drop your fee toward 18%.
catches: Trial (first) lesson pays $0 - 100% commission goes to Preply.
Commission starts at 33% and only drops toward 18% as you accumulate teaching hours.
Account balances can expire after 180 days of inactivity per Preply Terms.
Withdrawal fees apply (e.g., $1.13 fixed for US bank transfer) plus FX fees on non-USD payouts.
No guaranteed bookings - earnings depend on winning students in a crowded marketplace.

payout_quote: Tutors set their own hourly rate (typical subject rates $10.00-$38.90/hr, average $18.30/hr per Preply's official tutor blog; popular tutors earn up to $550/week). Trial lesson commission is 100%; subsequent commission starts at 33% and falls to 18% as you teach more hours.
steps: Create a tutor profile at preply.com/en/teach and record an intro video.
Set your hourly rate and open your availability calendar.
Students book lessons; earnings are released after each completed lesson.
Withdraw anytime via PayPal, Payoneer, Skrill, Wise, or bank transfer (min $10 for bank transfer).
timing: Official Help Center: 'You can withdraw your money whenever you want - no more waiting for payday!' Minimum withdrawal $10 via bank transfer; fees shown on the confirmation screen before you confirm (e.g., $1.13 fixed fee for US bank transfer).
maximize: Price honestly within Preply's official typical range ($10-$38.90/hr, average $18.30): your first lesson with each new student is a trial that pays you $0 under Preply's 100% trial commission, so set a rate that converts trials into packages. Commission starts at 33% and falls to 18% as your accumulated teaching hours grow - the more you teach, the more of each lesson you keep. Withdraw whenever you want with a $10 minimum via bank transfer (fees shown before you confirm), and teach at least once every 180 days because inactive balances can expire.
